{{Quote|I am investigating the military buildup here in Restuss. It has already caused the entire city to be evacuated, displacing thousands of families. And with tensions running high there is sure to be a showdown.|[[Marles Jacobe]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TBoR" />}}
The '''Restuss refugee camp''' was a refugee camp and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] built on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This camp was constructed a short distance of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Restuss]] in consequence to the evacuation of the city during the military buildup leading to the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SWG:TBoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Restuss refugee camp was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBoR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Restuss refugee camp was added to the game along with the "[[W:c:swg:Restuss|Battle of Restuss]]" [[Wikipedia:Player versus player|PvP]] battlefield,<ref name="SWG:TBoR" /> introduced in the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1.1|Chapter 1.1]]" released on [[June 27]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
